IDXX.headline: IDEXX Sales Rise 10% as Margin Outlook Slips: Rapid Earnings Reaction
IDXX.description: IDEXX Laboratories reported Q3 2026 revenue growth of 10% to $1.21 billion, driven by 11% growth in recurring diagnostics sales. While the company raised its 2026 earnings forecast and shares surged 16%, the profit increase stems from tax benefits, lower interest costs, and buybacks rather than testing demand. Notably, IDEXX trimmed its operating margin outlook, with Q4 expected to show minimal margin improvement as the company absorbs costs from its CoVet software acquisition.

IDXX.headline: Charles River's Q3 Earnings on Deck: What's in Store for the Stock?
IDXX.description: Charles River Laboratories is expected to report Q3 2026 results on November 4 with 22.6% EPS growth despite a projected 4.8% revenue decline. The RMS segment faces weak academic demand but benefits from stronger China demand, while DSA shows improving biopharmaceutical demand with strong booking trends. Manufacturing Solutions is supported by Microbial Solutions strength, though recent divestitures will impact overall growth rates.

IDXX.headline: Idexx Laboratories (IDXX) Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
IDXX.description: Idexx Laboratories reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.98 per share, beating consensus estimates of $3.71, with revenues of $1.21 billion exceeding expectations. Despite consistent earnings beats over four quarters, the stock has declined 18.5% year-to-date versus the S&P 500's 10.7% gain. The company holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating with favorable estimate revision trends, though near-term performance will depend on management guidance.
